A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''market stand owner''' was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This vendor owned a stand in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]]. When [[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]] [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] was sent by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to snatch [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], the latter used his suction cup cable on this vendor's stand and pulled it down in front of the pursuers in an attempt to slow them down.

==Behind the scenes==
This owner belonged to the same [[Species/Legends|species]] as [[Rangthang/Legends|Rang Thang]] and was voiced by [[Terrence Carson]].
